title: Present perfect (Form and use) - Introduction to present perfect

options.answer: I have seen this movie yesterday.
I have seen this movie before.
I have see this movie before.

explanation.en: Present perfect uses 'have/has + past participle' and shows completed actions with present relevance, not specific past times.
explanation.ru: Present perfect использует 'have/has + причастие прошедшего времени' и показывает завершенные действия с настоящей значимостью, а не конкретное прошедшее время.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'have/has + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' ishlatadi va hozirgi paytga tegishli bo'lgan tugallangan harakatlarni bildiradi, aniq o'tgan vaqtni emas.

options.answer: She has wrote three letters today.
She has written three letters today.
She have written three letters today.

explanation.en: Present perfect requires 'has' with third person singular and the correct past participle 'written', not 'wrote'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect требует 'has' с третьим лицом единственного числа и правильное причастие прошедшего времени 'written', а не 'wrote'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect uchinchi shaxs birlikda 'has' va to'g'ri o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'written'ni talab qiladi, 'wrote' emas.

options.answer: They has lived here for five years.
They have lived here for five years.
They have live here for five years.

explanation.en: Present perfect with plural subjects uses 'have' plus the past participle 'lived', not the base form 'live'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с подлежащими во множественном числе использует 'have' плюс причастие прошедшего времени 'lived', а не основную форму 'live'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect ko'plik sub'ektlar bilan 'have' va o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'lived'ni ishlatadi, asosiy shakl 'live' emas.

options.answer: Have you ever been to Paris?
Have you ever been to Paris?
Did you ever been to Paris?

explanation.en: Present perfect questions use 'Have/Has + subject + past participle' for experiences without specific time references.
explanation.ru: Вопросы в present perfect используют 'Have/Has + подлежащее + причастие прошедшего времени' для опыта без конкретных временных ссылок.
explanation.uz: Present perfect savollar aniq vaqt ko'rsatmasdan tajriba uchun 'Have/Has + ega + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' ishlatadi.

options.answer: I haven't never been to Japan.
I have never been to Japan.
I haven't ever been to Japan never.

explanation.en: Present perfect negative uses 'have not/haven't' or 'never' but not double negatives like 'haven't never'.
explanation.ru: Отрицательная форма present perfect использует 'have not/haven't' или 'never', но не двойные отрицания как 'haven't never'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect inkor shakli 'have not/haven't' yoki 'never' ishlatadi, lekin 'haven't never' kabi qo'sh inkor ishlatmaydi.

options.answer: We has just finished our homework.
We have just finished our homework.
We have just finish our homework.

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'just' uses 'have' with plural subjects and requires the past participle 'finished'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с 'just' использует 'have' с подлежащими во множественном числе и требует причастие прошедшего времени 'finished'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'just' bilan ko'plik egalarda 'have' va o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'finished'ni ishlatadi.

options.answer: He have already eaten lunch.
He has already eaten lunch.
He has already ate lunch.

explanation.en: Present perfect with third person singular uses 'has' and the past participle 'eaten', not the past tense 'ate'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с третьим лицом единственного числа использует 'has' и причастие прошедшего времени 'eaten', а не прошедшее время 'ate'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect uchinchi shaxs birlikda 'has' va o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'eaten'ni ishlatadi, o'tgan zamon 'ate' emas.

options.answer: She hasn't came home yet.
She hasn't come home yet.
She hasn't coming home yet.

explanation.en: Present perfect negative uses 'hasn't/haven't + past participle', so 'come' is correct, not 'came' or 'coming'.
explanation.ru: Отрицательная форма present perfect использует 'hasn't/haven't + причастие прошедшего времени', поэтому правильно 'come', а не 'came' или 'coming'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect inkor shakli 'hasn't/haven't + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' ishlatadi, shuning uchun 'come' to'g'ri, 'came' yoki 'coming' emas.

options.answer: How long do you live here?
How long have you lived here?
How long are you living here?

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'How long' shows duration from past to present, using 'have/has + past participle'.
explanation.ru: Present perfect с 'How long' показывает продолжительность от прошлого к настоящему, используя 'have/has + причастие прошедшего времени'.
explanation.uz: Present perfect 'How long' bilan o'tmishdan hozirgi vaqtgacha davomiylikni ko'rsatadi, 'have/has + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi' ishlatadi.

options.answer: I have went to the store.
I have gone to the store.
I have go to the store.

explanation.en: The past participle of 'go' is 'gone', not 'went' (which is past tense) or 'go' (base form).
explanation.ru: Причастие прошедшего времени от 'go' это 'gone', а не 'went' (прошедшее время) или 'go' (основная форма).
explanation.uz: 'Go' fe'lining o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi 'gone', 'went' (o'tgan zamon) yoki 'go' (asosiy shakl) emas.
